BEE Mandates QR Code for Star Rating Labels on Appliances: Explained

BEE Mandates QR Code for Star Rating Labels on Appliances: Explained

Abhishek Shukla

Oct 09, 2025

(https://www.encstore.com/blog/barcoding) Barcode

I see many Indian consumers who are actively looking for the star label affixed on appliances like Air Conditioners, refrigerators, ceiling fans, geysers, washing machines, LED lights, televisions, etc., while they go shopping. These star labels are affixed on a wide array of products to give consumers information on the performance of the product, helping them understand cost and energy-saving potential at the time of purchase.

In India,  (https://beestarlabel.com/) the Bureau of Energy Efficiency (BEE), under the Ministry of Power, the govt. of India, oversees this crucial aspect of consumer satisfaction and transparency.

Suggested Products

Why a QR Code-based Solution?

Now, these star labels can be misused as well. All an appliance manufacturing firm has to do is print and affix these labels, and the customers will be under the impression that it is authentic and regulated by the government.

To curb any such potential misadventure, BEE now aims to implement a QR Code in the present system of star labels on products. This will allow customers to retrieve and verify the details on a star label by simply scanning the QR Code on the star label. The data from the registered appliance database of BEE will be linked with the QR Code on each such product.

It’s a fail-proof way for appliance manufacturers to authenticate the star label on their products and boost customer trust with transparency.

QR Code Product Authentication and Anti-counterfeiting

Similarly, a QR Code-based solution can also be used for product authentication and preventing counterfeiting of branded items. Certain brands that deal with luxury retail items, medicines, and high-value items like wine, etc., have already started to use QR codes for real-time product authentication, where customers can scan the QR Code on the product packaging, which directs them to the official brand page where the product is authenticated.

Lately, QR Code technology is increasingly being used in India to streamline various product and service-related areas, boosting transparency, customer satisfaction, and customer trust.

BEE Mobile App for Star Label Scanning

Each genuine BEE Star Label will now carry a unique QR code that can be scanned by consumers using the  (https://www.beestarlabel.com/Home/MobileApp) BEE Star Label mobile application. Scanning the QR code instantly verifies product authenticity and provides access to real-time information from BEE’s centralized S&L database, making the system more reliable and fail-proof against counterfeiting.

The (https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.beestarlabel&pcampaignid=web_share) BEE Star Label App, available on both Android and iOS, connects directly with the BEE’s live database to deliver accurate and updated information daily. Through this app, consumers can make informed choices by comparing products on the basis of energy efficiency, potential savings, and performance.

How can an Appliance Manufacturer Integrate a QR Code on a Product Star Label?
